notes.subject: התכבד
notes.rationale: Literally 'make yourself heavy'; KJV 'make yourself many', YLT keeps 'heavy' — heavy swarms of locusts, so 'many' is implied; rendered 'i yɛrɛ jɔ' (make yourself heavy) to keep the shape.

notes.subject: ילק / ארבה
notes.rationale: Two names of locust stages (young locust, swarming locust) paired in parallel; the Hebrew pile-up of locust words is flattened into zɛnɛden/zɛnɛcaman.

notes.subject: Nineve
notes.rationale: The suffixes on תאכלך and תכריתך are feminine singular — Nineveh addressed as a woman, continuing from v.14.

translation: Yen, tasuma bɛ i dun; npan bɛ i ge; a bɛ i dun i n'a fɔ zɛnɛden ye. I yɛrɛ jɔ i n'a fɔ zɛnɛden ye; i yɛrɛ jɔ i n'a fɔ zɛnɛcaman ye.
